/* V0.5 hub / bottom navigation / ranking - no bottom nav in immersion game */
.page.normal-page{background:linear-gradient(178deg,#08182b 0%,#07101c 50%,#081422 100%)}
.bottom-nav{position:absolute;z-index:8;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:83px;background:#0b1b2dfa;border-top:1px solid #254457;display:flex;align-items:stretch;padding:7px 8px 10px;gap:5px;box-shadow:0 -9px 34px #03070c73}
.nav-item{border:0;color:#85a4b9;background:transparent;min-width:0;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:4px;border-radius:12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600}
.nav-item svg{width:23px;height:23px}
.nav-item.active{color:#68e2d6;background:#15384b}
.hub-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:2px 0 20px}
.brand-mark{width:42px;height:42px;border:1px solid #4b938f;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#214e61,#0a2439);border-radius:13px;color:#9bf1e0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:27px}
.hub-eyebrow{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.35px;color:#76babb;font-weight:800}
.hub-head h2{font-size:23px;margin:2px 0 0;letter-spacing:.6px}
.hub-gear{border:1px solid #35566b;color:#b8d6e6;background:#13293c;width:43px;height:43px;border-radius:13px;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-left:auto}
.identity-strip{display:flex;align-items:center;text-align:left;width:100%;background:#152b3d;border:1px solid #2e4e5e;border-radius:16px;padding:12px 13px;color:#e3f5ff;gap:12px}
.user-avatar,.profile-avatar{display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #6eb3b2;background:radial-gradient(circle at 27% 20%,#398995,#12435b);color:#e4fbfc;font-weight:900;border-radius:13px;width:42px;height:42px;font-size:20px}
.identity-strip b{display:block;font-size:15px}.identity-strip i{font-style:normal;font-size:11px;color:#8cd9d6;margin-left:6px}.identity-strip small{font-size:10px;color:#a6bdcd;margin-top:2px;display:block}.identity-strip .identity-pts{margin-left:auto;color:#ebc680;font-size:13px;font-weight:800}
.feature-title,.hub-section-title{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;margin:22px 1px 12px;gap:10px}.feature-title span,.hub-section-title span{font-size:17px;font-weight:850}.feature-title small,.hub-section-title small{font-size:10px;color:#83a3b7;text-align:right;max-width:175px}
.hero-card{height:322px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:21px;background:#0c2236;border:1px solid #326279;box-shadow:0 14px 34px #0006}
.hero-card>img{position:absolute;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 47%;filter:brightness(.95)}
.hero-vignette{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0b1e31f0 4%,#0b1e316c 80%),linear-gradient(0deg,#081929ec 0%,transparent 75%)}
.hero-content{position:absolute;inset:17px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}.task-tag{font-size:10px;color:#6fe1cd;background:#103644d9;border:1px solid #386a74;border-radius:99px;padding:6px 10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.6px}
.hero-content h3{font-size:25px;line-height:1.37;margin:17px 0 8px;letter-spacing:.6px;text-shadow:0 1px 7px #001}.hero-content p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.8;color:#b0d0dd;max-width:240px;margin:0}.hero-stats{display:flex;gap:15px;color:#9bb8c8;font-size:11px;margin-top:12px}.hero-stats b{color:#f2d197}.hero-cta{margin-top:auto;background:linear-gradient(115deg,#ffe3ae,#e7b877);border:0;border-radius:12px;color:#11263c;width:100%;padding:13px 16px;text-align:left;font-size:15px;font-weight:900;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.hub-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:11px}.hub-grid .hub-entry{margin:0;min-height:101px;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px;gap:6px}.hub-grid .hub-entry-icon{width:34px;height:34px}.hub-grid .hub-entry-copy{width:calc(100% - 48px)}.hub-grid .hub-entry-copy b{font-size:13px}.hub-grid .hub-entry-copy small{font-size:10px}.hub-grid .hub-chevron{display:none}
.hub-entry{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;width:100%;padding:13px 12px;margin-bottom:10px;background:#13283a;border:1px solid #2c5065;color:#eaf9fe;border-radius:15px;text-align:left;min-height:72px}.hub-entry-icon{flex-shrink:0;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:11px;background:#163d4e;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#5ce0d8}.hub-entry-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:0}.hub-entry-copy b{font-size:14px}.hub-entry-copy small{color:#8ea8b8;font-size:11px}.hub-chevron{margin-left:auto;color:#90abba;display:flex}.hub-chevron svg{width:17px}
.hub-notice,.page-disclaimer{font-size:10px;color:#7592a3;text-align:center;line-height:1.65;margin:18px 0}
.page-head{margin-bottom:22px}.page-head h2{font-size:21px}.page-head small{font-size:11px}.page-head .back{flex-shrink:0}
.settings-group,.record-list{border:1px solid #2b4b63;background:#11263b;border-radius:17px;padding:14px;margin:15px 0}.settings-group>.hub-entry{background:#172f47;margin:6px 0;border:0}.settings-group h3{font-size:16px}.settings-group p{font-size:12px;color:#a4bfcf;line-height:1.9}.group-label{color:#79e1d7;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.7px;font-weight:850;margin:0 0 10px}
.listrow span small{display:block;color:#88a5b8;margin:5px 0 0;font-size:10px}.togglebtn{min-width:62px}
.archive-intro,.civil-hero,.gift-hero{padding:22px 19px;min-height:170px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 90% 20%,#225067,#122e44 52%,#0f2638);border:1px solid #326078;border-radius:19px}.archive-intro .tiny,.civil-hero .tiny,.gift-hero .tiny{color:#6fd7d0;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;font-weight:800}.archive-intro h3,.civil-hero h3,.gift-hero h3{font-size:20px;line-height:1.45;margin:12px 0 8px}.archive-intro p,.civil-hero p,.gift-hero p{font-size:11px;color:#b6cbd5;line-height:1.75;margin:0}.record-empty{color:#a1bdc9;font-size:12px;line-height:1.9;padding:20px 0}.record-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #31516a}.record-row:last-child{border:0}.record-row>span{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#1e5155;color:#7de7d2}.record-row b{font-size:13px}.record-row small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#84a8b7;margin-top:4px}.record-row i{font-style:normal;margin-left:auto;color:#e8c584}.secondary-cta{border:1px solid #477e85;border-radius:12px;padding:14px;background:#194453;color:#d4f3f0;width:100%;font-weight:800}
.profile-hero{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1d4554,#102438 70%);padding:23px 15px 16px;border-radius:19px;border:1px solid #2c6571;text-align:center}.profile-avatar{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:18px;font-size:27px;margin:auto}.profile-hero h3{font-size:24px;margin:12px 0 2px}.profile-hero p{font-size:11px;color:#a6c9d6;margin:0}.profile-metrics{display:flex;justify-content:space-around;margin-top:22px;border-top:1px solid #3d6173;padding-top:15px}.profile-metrics div{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.profile-metrics strong{font-size:24px;color:#eac788}.profile-metrics small{color:#92b0bd;font-size:11px}
.podium{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:end;gap:8px;margin:23px 0}.podium-card{height:114px;flex:1;min-width:0;border-radius:14px;text-align:center;padding:12px 5px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#203849,#13283d);border:1px solid #405a69;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}.podium-card.first{height:142px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#51422f,#1f3543 70%);border-color:#b5945b}.podium-card>span{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.4px;color:#8baebd}.podium-card strong{font-size:29px;line-height:1.15;margin:2px 0;color:#85bdce}.podium-card.first strong{font-size:36px;color:#ffd996}.podium-card b{font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;max-width:102px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.podium-card small{font-size:10px;color:#adc3cf;margin-top:4px}
.rank-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 9px;color:#83a8ba;font-size:10px}.rank-list{border:1px solid #2c4a5f;border-radius:15px;background:#0d2234;overflow:hidden}.rankcell{padding:11px 8px;min-height:54px;gap:8px;border-bottom-color:#20394d}.rankcell .ranknum{color:#80a1b1;width:22px;font-size:11px}.rank-avatar{border:1px solid #39767c;background:#1d4b59;width:29px;height:29px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#98e6d9;font-size:13px}.rank-user{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;flex:1;min-width:0}.rank-user b{font-size:12px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.rank-user small{font-size:10px;color:#6fb4b8}.rankcell strong{font-size:13px;color:#e4eef2}.rankcell.mine{border-radius:0;background:#1a4b64}.rank-mine{position:sticky;bottom:-112px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#19495e;border:1px solid #4a9c9b;padding:11px 14px;margin:11px 0;border-radius:14px}.rank-mine span{font-size:10px;color:#82d9d4}.rank-mine b{font-size:17px}.rank-mine em{font-style:normal;color:#eaf5fa;font-size:12px}.rank-mine strong{margin-left:auto;color:#f5cb7f;font-size:17px}
/* Leaderboard: make personal rank independently visible above global navigation. */
.rank-list{max-height:247px;overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#375f70 transparent}
.rank-mine{position:relative;bottom:auto;margin:10px 0 0;min-height:57px}

/* ===== NeuroTrace V0.8 UX revision ===== */
.page.normal-page{height:calc(100% - 76px);padding:0 15px 8px;overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#345b6b transparent}
.global-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;height:66px;padding:10px 2px 8px;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}
.global-game-header{top:20px;left:16px;right:16px}
.global-profile{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0;max-width:166px;width:156px;text-align:left;color:#e8f8fa;border:1px solid #385b6d;background:#0b2235e0;border-radius:16px;padding:6px 9px;height:49px}
.mini-avatar{height:32px;width:32px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#4cb8b6,#1b5269);border:1px solid #74d1c9;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;flex-shrink:0}
.mini-identity{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;min-width:0}.mini-identity b{font-size:12px;font-weight:850;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.mini-identity small{font-size:10px;color:#a6c0ca}
.global-header-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center}
.global-tool{width:45px;height:45px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #3b6477;border-radius:14px;background:#0b2539df;color:#c1e0ee}
.global-tool svg{width:21px;height:21px}.global-tool:active{background:#214258}
.scene-top-actions{top:97px;left:16px;right:16px}
.game-entries{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.scene-entry{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:#112b3bca;border:1px solid #396879;border-radius:12px;padding:0 10px;height:40px;color:#d5f1f4;font-size:12px;font-weight:750}
.scene-entry svg{width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--cyan)}.entry-count{font-size:10px;color:#c6bfa4;border-left:1px solid #416275;padding-left:6px}
.trace-indicator{top:150px;left:23px;right:23px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:10px;color:#8cb5c6;letter-spacing:.2px;text-shadow:0 1px 6px #000}
.trace-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#77dfd7;box-shadow:0 0 8px #6de9de}.trace-progress{margin-left:auto}
.game-goal{bottom:155px;left:20px;right:88px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;pointer-events:none}
.game-goal span{font-size:10px;color:#79c7c5;text-shadow:0 2px 5px #001}.game-goal strong{font-size:15px;color:#e0f3f6;text-shadow:0 2px 10px #000}
.view-trigger{bottom:152px;right:12px;width:52px;height:54px;border-radius:14px;background:#0b2a3dc4;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.game-actions{bottom:83px;height:56px;left:14px;right:14px;gap:7px;align-items:stretch}
.game-actions .square-action{width:61px;height:55px;gap:2px;font-size:10px;border-radius:14px;background:#0b2133b8;border-color:#3a6377;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.game-actions .square-action .glyph{font-size:21px;line-height:1}
.game-actions .compact-confirm{height:55px;min-width:110px;flex:1;font-size:15px;font-weight:850;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 5px 20px #07101ab0}
.game-actions .compact-confirm:disabled{background:#566d7cdd;color:#132a36}
.game-actions .selected-tool{border-color:#6bc8bb;color:#c8faf4}
.bottom-nav{height:76px;padding:6px 8px 8px;background:#071928ea;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:0 -8px 25px #02091066}
.bottom-nav .nav-item svg{width:21px;height:21px}.bottom-nav .nav-item{gap:3px;font-size:11px}
.quiet-endpoint{opacity:.30;box-shadow:none!important}.quiet-endpoint.selected{opacity:.68}
.scene-zoom{bottom:0}.scene-base{object-position:center center}
.compact-sheet{min-height:290px;padding-bottom:22px}.task-sheet-progress{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:6px 0 18px;color:#b5d0dc}.task-sheet-progress div:first-child{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}.task-sheet-progress small{font-size:11px}.task-sheet-progress strong{color:#f3d397}.task-sheet-progress .track{width:160px}
.inline-archive{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid #3d7581;border-radius:12px;background:#1b3a4e;color:#d4f1f2;font-size:13px;width:100%;height:44px}.inline-archive svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.page-context{height:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin:5px 3px 15px;color:#7eb9c1;font-size:11px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.5px}.page-context button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#9fc2d2;width:34px;height:26px;display:grid;place-items:center}.page-context svg{height:17px;width:17px}
.page.normal-page>.global-header{margin-bottom:8px}
.rank-page{display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden!important;height:calc(100% - 76px)!important;padding-bottom:0!important}
.rank-page>.global-header{flex-shrink:0;margin-bottom:7px!important}
.rank-page .rank-tabs{flex-shrink:0;margin:0 0 8px}.rank-page .rank-tabs button{padding:9px}
.rank-page .podium{margin:7px 0 8px;gap:7px;flex-shrink:0}.rank-page .podium-card{height:105px;padding:9px 4px}.rank-page .podium-card.first{height:123px}.rank-page .podium-card strong{font-size:27px}.rank-page .podium-card.first strong{font-size:31px}
.rank-page .rank-header{flex-shrink:0;padding:8px 8px}
.rank-page .rank-list{flex:1;max-height:none;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;margin:0;scrollbar-width:thin}
.rank-page .rankcell{min-height:57px;padding:10px 8px}
.rank-page .rank-mine{position:relative;bottom:auto;flex-shrink:0;margin:0;height:62px;border-radius:0;border-top:1px solid #5faaa6;border-bottom:0}
.page.normal-page .archive-intro{margin-top:0}
.v06-finished{top:45%!important;transform:translateY(-50%);left:25px;right:25px}
.toast{z-index:25}

/* ===== V1.0: three stable main tabs + independently navigated secondary screens ===== */
.global-header{height:69px;gap:10px;padding:9px 0 5px}
.global-game-header{top:16px;left:14px;right:14px}
.global-profile{height:55px;width:221px;max-width:221px;gap:8px;border-radius:14px;padding:5px 8px;background:#0b2639d9;flex:0 1 221px}
.mini-avatar{height:34px;width:34px;font-size:15px;flex-shrink:0}
.identity-stats{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;align-items:start;flex:1;min-width:0}
.identity-name{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:baseline;font-size:12px;font-weight:850;white-space:nowrap}.identity-name small{font-size:9px;color:#aac2cb;font-weight:500}
.identity-resources{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;font-size:11px;color:#d5dce6}.energy-symbol{color:#8de6e0}.credit-symbol{color:#eed4a3}
.energy-meter{height:4px;width:37px;display:block;overflow:hidden;border-radius:5px;background:#395a66}.energy-meter i{display:block;width:63%;height:100%;background:#7ad7cb;border-radius:5px}
.global-header-actions{gap:7px;flex:0 0 auto}.global-tool{height:45px;width:45px;border-radius:13px}.global-tool svg{height:21px;width:21px}
.scene-top-actions{top:92px;left:14px;right:14px}.game-entries{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.entry-main,.entry-utilities{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.scene-entry{height:39px;padding:0 8px;gap:5px;border-radius:12px;font-size:11px;background:#102b3dbb;white-space:nowrap}
.scene-entry svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:#63cfc8;flex-shrink:0}.entry-count{font-size:10px;padding-left:5px}
.utility-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;height:39px;width:39px;flex:0 0 39px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #406577;background:#0b2b3ebd;color:#b4dfe7}
.utility-icon svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.trace-indicator,.game-goal,.view-trigger{display:none!important}
.game-actions{bottom:84px;left:11px;right:11px;gap:6px;height:54px}
.game-actions .square-action{width:58px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;background:#0a2030a9;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.game-actions .compact-confirm{min-width:105px;flex:1;height:52px;border-radius:14px;font-size:14px;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#f5d7a6,#dcae72)}
.game-actions .compact-confirm:disabled{background:#50646fa6;color:#17232e}
.bottom-nav{height:76px;padding:7px 9px 9px;gap:7px}.bottom-nav .nav-item{flex:1}
/* Only secondary screens have a back control and context title; no persistent tab bar. */
.secondary-page{height:100%!important;padding:19px 16px 18px!important;overflow-y:auto!important}
.subpage-head{height:57px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:0 0 15px 0;font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:#e8f4fa}
.subpage-back{width:39px;height:39px;border-radius:13px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#112b3b;border:1px solid #3b6070;color:#b4d9e6}
.subpage-back svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.page-context{display:none!important}
.main-tab-page{height:calc(100% - 76px)!important}
.main-tab-page>.global-header{margin-bottom:7px}
.rank-page{padding:0 12px 0!important}
.rank-page>.global-header{margin-bottom:4px!important;flex-shrink:0}
.rank-page .rank-tabs{margin-bottom:7px}
.rank-page .podium{margin:5px 0 8px;flex-shrink:0}
.rank-page .rank-list{flex:1;min-height:0;max-height:none}
.rank-page .rank-mine{height:60px;margin:0;flex-shrink:0}
.profile-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px;margin-top:18px}
.profile-metrics div{min-width:0}.profile-metrics div strong{font-size:15px}
@media (max-width:395px){.global-profile{width:215px;max-width:215px}.global-header-actions{gap:5px}}

/* V0.8 MULTIMODAL ASSET EXPERIMENT — images are decoration; UI/interaction stays DOM */
:root {--bg:#040e1b;--panel:#10253b;--panel2:#173349;--line:#2d6e84;--cyan:#79edec;--gold:#f8c986}
#app{background:#040d1a}
#game-screen{background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(2,11,22,.6),rgba(2,13,30,.52) 50%,rgba(1,8,19,.72)),url('data:image/webp;base64,');background-position:center;background-size:cover}
.scene-zoom{background:none!important}
.scene-base.art-scene{position:absolute!important;top:155px!important;left:-9px!important;width:408px!important;height:526px!important;object-fit:fill!important;opacity:.97;mix-blend-mode:screen;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px #0769ac50);mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0%,black 8%,black 92%,transparent 100%);pointer-events:none}
.palette-violet .scene-base.art-scene{filter:hue-rotate(65deg) saturate(1.2)}
.palette-contrast .scene-base.art-scene{filter:contrast(1.48) brightness(1.15)}
.points-only .scene-base.art-scene{opacity:.3}
.node-hit.a{left:210px;top:409px}.node-hit.b{left:290px;top:355px}
.node-hit{width:39px;height:39px;box-shadow:0 0 0 9px #19dee323,0 0 14px #36c9ec99;background:#02b9cf13;z-index:3}
.node-hit::after{top:12.5px;left:12.5px}
.current-connect path{stroke-width:4;stroke-dasharray:5 6}
.global-game-header{top:11px!important}.scene-top-actions{top:88px!important}
.global-header{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#071a2bdf,#10334d94);border:1px solid #376e82;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 16px #0a729048,0 4px 22px #0005;padding:6px 8px!important;height:70px!important}
.global-game-header .global-header{backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.global-profile{background:none!important;border:0!important;padding:0!important}
.global-profile .mini-avatar,.profile-avatar{background-image:url('data:image/webp;base64,')!important;background-position:center;background-size:cover;border:0!important;color:transparent!important;box-shadow:0 0 15px #39d3ed50}
.global-profile .mini-avatar{width:43px!important;height:43px!important;flex-shrink:0}
.global-header-actions{gap:4px!important}.global-tool{border:0!important;background:transparent!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px #36d9e660)}
.scene-entry,.utility-icon{backdrop-filter:blur(8px);box-shadow:0 0 10px #12b5cf18,inset 0 0 7px #2bbed21f;background:#0a1e2caa!important;border-color:#40849b!important}
.game-actions .square-action{background:#071b2cbb!important;border-color:#4695a3!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 7px #00a7dd25}
.game-actions .compact-confirm{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#ffe1a6,#efb766)!important;color:#122237!important;box-shadow:0 0 21px #efb7664d;font-weight:800}
.game-actions .compact-confirm:disabled{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#395665,#31556a)!important;color:#a8c6d2!important;opacity:.84}
.bottom-nav{border-top:1px solid #4089a6!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0b2936ef,#061a2dfe)!important;box-shadow:0 -5px 20px #06b5dc27!important}
.bottom-nav .nav-item.active{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#153f5188,#052736ad)!important;border-color:#397e8e!important}
.page{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#061528d8,#061526ef),url('data:image/webp;base64,') center center/cover!important}
.rank-page{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#061628ea,#061422e8),url('data:image/webp;base64,') center center/cover!important}
.podium.art-podium{gap:7px;height:158px!important;align-items:flex-end!important;margin-bottom:8px!important}
.art-podium .podium-card{height:128px!important;padding:5px 3px 8px!important;display:flex!important;justify-content:flex-end!important;gap:2px!important;background:linear-gradient(170deg,#071e34ba,#123c5788)!important;border:1px solid #328ba499!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 18px #0a83913d}
.art-podium .podium-card.first{height:153px!important;border-color:#e0b874aa!important;background:linear-gradient(170deg,#1f2838b3,#42362777)!important;box-shadow:0 0 17px #f5c27f3d,inset 0 0 25px #d09f4677}
.art-podium .podium-card.third{border-color:#c9976c88!important}
.podium-medal{object-fit:contain;width:92px;height:76px;display:block;max-width:100%;margin:0 auto -2px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px #3ad6f266)}
.art-podium .first .podium-medal{width:104px;height:88px}
.art-podium .podium-card b{font-size:12px!important;color:#edf9ff;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;max-width:100%}
.art-podium .podium-card small{font-size:10px!important;color:#b8dce7}
.rank-avatar-art{width:29px;height:29px;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid #4ec4e8;border-radius:9px;flex:none;box-shadow:0 0 8px #2adaff3b}
.rank-page .rankcell{background:linear-gradient(95deg,#0d344866,#091b3090)!important;border-bottom-color:#305571!important}
.rank-page .rank-mine{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#61492a88,#142a42dd)!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 18px #f2bc6930}
.archive-hero-art{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:13px;border:1px solid #3995b1;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#0d3348de,#0c253bc9);border-radius:18px;padding:9px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 22px #007eaa23}
.archive-hero-art>img{width:135px;height:106px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #2bd2de6b;flex:none}
.archive-hero-art>div{flex:1;min-width:0}.archive-hero-art h3{font-size:16px;margin:5px 0;line-height:1.35}.archive-hero-art p{font-size:11px;color:#acc5d7;margin:3px 0 9px}
.archive-tag{font-size:10px;color:var(--gold);border:1px solid #d1ad6f89;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:12px}
.archive-hero-stat{font-size:11px;color:var(--cyan)}
.archive-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:12px 0}.archive-tabs span{flex:1;text-align:center;background:#0f2c42;border:1px solid #306077;padding:9px;border-radius:12px;font-size:12px}.archive-tabs .active{border-color:#e5bc77;color:#f2d19d;background:#342c27}
.archive-example-hint{font-size:10px;color:#c2b09f;margin:10px 0;line-height:1.5}
.archive-art-list{display:grid;gap:8px}.archive-art-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid #2d657d;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#0d2e45dd,#10263bb8);padding:6px;border-radius:12px;min-height:71px}
.archive-art-row>img{width:72px;height:55px;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid #2b91a8;border-radius:8px;flex-shrink:0}
.archive-row-text{min-width:0;flex:1;display:grid;gap:5px}.archive-row-text strong{font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.archive-row-text span{font-size:10px;color:#acc6d7}.archive-art-row small{font-size:10px;color:var(--gold)}
.archive-meter{height:3px;background:#284659;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden}.archive-meter i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#2bc4d2,#86ffe9)}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.scene-zoom{transition:none!important}}


.mobile-workflow-trigger,.mobile-close-workflow,.mobile-workflow-scrim{display:none}.mobile-workflow-trigger{position:fixed;z-index:97;top:51%;left:0;writing-mode:vertical-rl;border:1px solid #3c96a5;border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;background:#0d3048df;color:#c3f6f6;padding:13px 7px;font-size:12px;box-shadow:0 0 12px #2fcaca48}.mobile-close-workflow{position:fixed;z-index:105;left:min(300px,calc(88vw - 40px));top:18px;width:32px;height:32px;background:#153648;color:#c8ffff;border:1px solid #57b3c1;border-radius:9px}.mobile-workflow-scrim{position:fixed;z-index:100;inset:0;background:#000a}
/* ===== V1.0 EXPERIENCE LAYER: design system, motion, review rail ===== */
:root{--glass:rgba(9,31,47,.83);--neon:#66ecdf;--halo:rgba(75,233,217,.26);--warm:#f3cc85;--edge:rgba(121,229,231,.46)}
body{background:radial-gradient(ellipse 650px 480px at 50% 15%,#12263a 0%,transparent 75%),linear-gradient(110deg,#060a14,#090d19 50%,#050b14)}
.workspace{gap:30px;max-width:1560px;align-items:center;padding:25px 30px}
.brief{width:340px;max-height:calc(100svh - 40px);overflow:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#234656 transparent;padding:5px 6px 8px 2px;align-self:center}
.brief-head{padding:0 3px 7px}
.brief h1{font-size:27px;letter-spacing:-.7px;margin:8px 0 10px}
.brief-head p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.8;color:#b2c8d2;margin:0 0 11px}
.brief h1 span{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.6px;color:var(--warm)}
.workflow-track{position:relative;display:grid;gap:7px;margin:11px 0 14px}
.workflow-track::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:18px;top:23px;bottom:24px;width:1px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#377c83,#233b51);opacity:.65}
.workflow-stage{border-radius:13px;border:1px solid rgba(82,135,159,.28);background:linear-gradient(140deg,rgba(20,40,62,.94),rgba(9,21,37,.97));box-shadow:inset 0 1px #ffffff0a;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .24s,background .24s}
.workflow-stage[open]{border-color:rgba(83,205,204,.62);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(18,56,67,.96),rgba(11,28,46,.98));box-shadow:0 5px 25px #0003,inset 0 1px #7de5de14}
.workflow-stage summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:11px 13px 11px 10px;list-style:none;cursor:pointer;min-height:53px}
.workflow-stage summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.stage-no{position:relative;z-index:2;width:20px;height:20px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:7px;background:#112e3f;border:1px solid #438e95;color:#8aeee7;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;flex-shrink:0}
.stage-main{display:grid;gap:3px;min-width:0;flex:1}.stage-main strong{font-size:12px;color:#e8fbff}.stage-main small{font-size:10px;color:#8dabbd;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.stage-chevron{font-size:16px;color:#8ccbd1;transform:rotate(0);transition:transform .2s}.workflow-stage[open] .stage-chevron{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.stage-detail{padding:0 12px 12px 42px}.stage-detail p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;color:#c0d9e2;margin:0 0 8px}.stage-detail div{display:grid;gap:3px;margin-top:8px}.stage-detail span{font-size:9px;color:#76adb7;letter-spacing:1px}.stage-detail code{font-family:ui-monospace,'SFMono-Regular',Consolas,monospace;font-size:10px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#f0d395;background:#101c2b;padding:5px 7px;border-radius:6px}.stage-detail b{font-size:10px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.55;color:#d8eaf1}
.workflow-footer{padding:12px 11px;border:1px solid #28465a;border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f2336,#0b192b);display:grid;gap:9px}.workflow-verified{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:10px;color:#b9d9e0}.workflow-verified i,.active-led{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#65e2c8;box-shadow:0 0 10px #65e2c8;display:inline-block}.workflow-footer a{font-size:10px;color:#b6dce2;text-decoration:none}.workflow-footer a:hover{color:#f5d895}
.inspector{width:255px}.inspector-summary{font-size:11px;color:#98b7c5;line-height:1.8;margin:0 0 12px}.inspector #inspector{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#111e32,#0d1929);border:1px solid #35586c;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #6ee4e30b,0 20px 60px #0003}.inspector .hint{font-size:11px;margin:12px 0;line-height:1.9}.inspector .reset-all{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#152d40,#0e2132);border-color:#42798a;font-size:12px;transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s}.inspector .reset-all:hover{border-color:#73d1d4;transform:translateY(-1px)}.inspector .motion-toggle{margin-bottom:9px}
.phone-holder{filter:drop-shadow(0 28px 40px #0009)}.stage-phone-label{position:absolute;top:-28px;left:3px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.1px;font-weight:700;color:#c9e7ec;white-space:nowrap;display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center}.stage-phone-label small{color:#78bfc3;letter-spacing:2px}
.phone{border:1px solid #4d8795;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #a5e7f350,0 0 2px #2ba7b9,0 16px 70px #000b,0 0 55px #0889a81c}
#app{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#071324 0%,#06111f 70%,#030b16)}
.scene-zoom::before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:1;inset:14% -30% 14%;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 35%,rgba(32,161,212,.12),transparent 48%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 65% 70%,rgba(0,133,217,.17),transparent 57%);mix-blend-mode:screen;animation:ambientFlow 11s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.scene-base{filter:saturate(1.32) contrast(1.12) brightness(.94);animation:sceneBreathe 8s ease-in-out infinite alternate;will-change:filter}
.particle-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;z-index:1}.particle-layer i{position:absolute;width:2px;height:2px;background:#aafafe;border-radius:100%;box-shadow:0 0 8px 1px #3fdedc;animation:particleDrift 11s linear infinite;opacity:.55}.particle-layer i:nth-child(1){top:23%;left:12%;animation-delay:-2s}.particle-layer i:nth-child(2){top:36%;left:78%;animation-delay:-5s}.particle-layer i:nth-child(3){top:48%;left:42%;animation-delay:-7s}.particle-layer i:nth-child(4){top:57%;left:88%;animation-delay:-1s}.particle-layer i:nth-child(5){top:71%;left:25%;animation-delay:-3s}.particle-layer i:nth-child(6){top:79%;left:63%;animation-delay:-9s}.particle-layer i:nth-child(7){top:26%;left:55%;animation-delay:-4s}.particle-layer i:nth-child(8){top:66%;left:8%;animation-delay:-6s}
.global-game-header .global-profile,.main-tab-page .global-profile{border-color:rgba(90,220,229,.54);border-radius:13px;background:linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(15,51,73,.95),rgba(9,27,46,.78));box-shadow:inset 0 1px #bcf5fa23,0 0 18px #23b2c21c;backdrop-filter:blur(13px)}
.mini-avatar{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#0b2649,#0c3658);color:#bdfdff;border:1px solid #6be1e8;box-shadow:0 0 16px #46c6ec6b,inset 0 0 10px #36cfee80;position:relative}
.global-tool{background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(12,48,66,.91),rgba(6,27,44,.9));border:1px solid rgba(99,205,223,.55);box-shadow:inset 0 1px #91dcec22,0 0 12px #41baef16;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);transition:transform .2s,background .2s,border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}.global-tool:hover,.global-tool:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:#b7eeee;box-shadow:0 0 13px #3bc8c35e,inset 0 1px #d8ffff44}.global-tool:active{transform:scale(.95)}
.scene-entry,.utility-icon{border:1px solid rgba(95,222,225,.65);background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(14,56,76,.82),rgba(7,32,51,.66));box-shadow:inset 0 1px #c0faff24,0 0 13px #0ba7c025;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s;color:#e6fcff}
.scene-entry:hover,.utility-icon:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:#b8faff;box-shadow:0 0 16px #52e6e464}.scene-entry:active,.utility-icon:active{transform:scale(.96)}
.entry-main .scene-entry:first-child{border-color:#74d5dc}.task-entry{position:relative}.task-entry::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-3px;top:-3px;width:7px;height:7px;background:#eccc80;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 9px #eccc80}
.node-hit{animation:nodeBreath 2.3s ease-in-out infinite;transition:transform .17s,filter .17s}.node-hit:active{transform:scale(.86)}.node-hit.selected{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px #c6ffef17,0 0 0 20px #23ecd91c,0 0 22px #88ffff80!important}

.game-actions .square-action:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:#c7ffff;box-shadow:0 0 22px #2cc9e06b,inset 0 1px #e5ffff44}.game-actions .square-action:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.95)}
.game-actions .square-action .glyph{font-size:22px;color:#c4fcff;text-shadow:0 0 12px #71ffff8f}.game-actions .square-action span:last-child{letter-spacing:.5px}
.game-actions .compact-confirm{height:58px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-width:0;font-size:17px;background:linear-gradient(115deg,#b87a3c,#ffdea0 35%,#f8c775 60%,#b97c43);border:1px solid #ffeab6;box-shadow:0 0 19px #f2b95575,inset 0 1px #ffffffe8,0 3px 18px #0007;text-shadow:0 1px #fff5;transition:box-shadow .2s,transform .2s,filter .2s}
.game-actions .compact-confirm::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;width:38%;transform:translateX(-230%) skewX(-21deg);background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#fff9,transparent);animation:buttonShine 5s 2s ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none}
.game-actions .compact-confirm:not(:disabled):hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 0 27px #f4c66dbf,inset 0 1px #fff,0 8px 24px #0008}
.game-actions .compact-confirm:disabled{filter:saturate(.57);background:linear-gradient(115deg,#84643b,#b9a078 45%,#967442);color:#24303c;border-color:#b99b6a;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #fff5,0 0 13px #e6be8153;opacity:.88}
.game-actions .compact-confirm:disabled::before{animation:none}

.archive-hero-art,.archive-art-row{border-color:#4b92a8;box-shadow:0 7px 26px #020b1673,inset 0 1px #d2faff22;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#102c42,#07192c)}
.archive-hero-art img,.archive-art-row img{filter:saturate(1.18) contrast(1.12);box-shadow:0 0 14px #13add13e}.archive-tabs .active{box-shadow:0 0 12px #d8b86842}
@keyframes sceneBreathe{from{filter:saturate(1.27) contrast(1.08) brightness(.88)}to{filter:saturate(1.48) contrast(1.19) brightness(1.04)}}
@keyframes ambientFlow{from{transform:translate(-4%,2%)}to{transform:translate(5%,-3%)}}
@keyframes particleDrift{0%{transform:translateY(15px);opacity:0}30%{opacity:.58}75%{opacity:.32}100%{transform:translateY(-35px);opacity:0}}
@keyframes nodeBreath{0%,100%{filter:brightness(1)}50%{filter:brightness(1.7)}}
@keyframes traceFlow{to{stroke-dashoffset:-30}}
@keyframes buttonShine{0%,73%{transform:translateX(-230%) skewX(-21deg)}94%,100%{transform:translateX(460%) skewX(-21deg)}}
.reduce-animations *, .reduce-animations *::before,.reduce-animations *::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
@media(max-width:1250px){.workspace{gap:18px}.brief{width:290px}.inspector{width:235px}}
@media(max-width:1000px){.workspace{gap:12px}.brief{width:255px}.inspector{width:215px}.stage-detail{padding-left:12px}}
@media(max-width:900px){.brief{display:block;position:fixed;z-index:101;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:min(340px,88vw);max-height:none;background:#07111f;padding:70px 13px 20px;box-shadow:10px 0 45px #000b;transform:translateX(-110%);transition:transform .25s}.workflow-open .brief{transform:translateX(0)}.workspace{padding:0;gap:0;display:block;height:100svh}.stage-phone-label{display:none}.phone-holder{margin:0 auto}.inspector{display:none}.phone{border:0;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none}.mobile-workflow-trigger{display:block!important}.mobile-close-workflow{display:block!important}.mobile-workflow-scrim{display:none}.workflow-open .mobile-workflow-scrim{display:block!important}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

  <div class="brief-head"><div class="eyebrow">LIVE CASE STUDY · 07 STAGES</div><h1>从设计到上线 <span>V1.0</span></h1><p>同一个项目，七个可复现的节点。点开任一步，查看它实际使用的工具、生成的文件和验收方式。</p></div>
  <div class="workflow-track"><details class="workflow-stage" ><summary><span class="stage-no">01</span><span class="stage-main"><strong>需求与信息架构</strong><small>ChatGPT + 人工评审</small></span><span 交接说明</small></span><span class="stage-chevron">⌄</span></summary><div class="stage-detail"><p>连接真实数据与算法；复用已批准 UI 组件和素材</p><div><span>交付物</span><code>docs/CODEX_HANDOFF.md</code></div><div><span>验收点</span><b>真实任务必须用实际科研影像替换示意图</b></div></div></details></div>
  <div class="workflow-footer"><div class="workflow-verified"><i></i><span>当前阶段：多模态原型＋交互视觉验收</span></div><a href="workflow.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">阅读完整复现教程 / 含命令 ↗</a><a href="https://playwright.dev/python/docs/screenshots" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Playwright 官方截图教程 ↗</a><a href="https://vercel.com/docs/deployments" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Vercel 官方部署说明 ↗</a></div>
 </aside>
 <div class="phone-holder"><div class="stage-phone-label"><span class="active-led"></span> 实时交互原型 <small>LIVE DEMO</small></div><div class="phone" id="phone"><div id="app" aria-live="polite"></div></div></div>
 <aside class="inspector"><div class="panelcap">交互状态 / STATE INSPECTOR</div><div class="inspector-summary">这里显示实际 JavaScript 状态，而不是设计图中的假数据。</div><div id="inspector"></div><div class="hint">操作中间的游戏界面，数值会立即更新。切换“减少动态效果”可查看动效降级效果；截图测试可用 Playwright 自动执行。</div><button id="toggle-demo-motion" class="reset-all motion-toggle">减少动态效果：关</button><button id="reset-all" class="reset-all">↻ 重置全部演示状态</button></aside>
</div>
<script>/* NeuroTrace V1.0: app information architecture + functional prototype.
   IMPORTANT: SIMULATED GRAPH CONNECTIVITY. Not scientific validation, no persistence/API. */
const state = {page:'game',previous:'game',viewOpen:false,taskOpen:false,supplyOpen:false,endpointsVisible:true,selectedA:true,selectedB:false,taskIndex:0,total:2,score:68,connections:[],palette:'cyan',mode:'fibers',zoom:1,sound:true,reducedMotion:false,toast:'',rankPeriod:'周榜'};
const $=sel=>document.querySelector(sel);
const embeddedThumbs=["data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,"];
const embeddedNav={"research": "data:image/webp;base64,", "civil": "data:image/webp;base64,", "rank": "data:image/webp;base64,"};
const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
function icon(name){const paths={gear:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M19 13a7 7 0 0 0 0-2l2-2-2-4-3 1-2-2H10L8 6 5 5 3 9l2 2v2l-2 2 2 4 3-1 2 2h4l2-2 3 1 2-4z"/>',back:'<path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6"/>',sliders:'<path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16"/><circle cx="9" cy="6" r="2" fill="#10293b"/><circle cx="16" cy="12" r="2" fill="#10293b"/><circle cx="7" cy="18" r="2" fill="#10293b"/>',archive:'<rect x="5" y="4" width="14" height="16" rx="1"/><path d="M8 9h8M8 13h8M8 17h6"/>',eye:'<path d="M2 12s4-7 10-7 10 7 10 7-4 7-10 7S2 12 2 12Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/>',user:'<circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 21c0-9 16-9 16 0"/>',check:'<path d="M4 12l5 5L20 6"/>','info':'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 11v6M12 7h.01"/>',star:'<path d="m12 2 3 7 7 3-7 3-3 7-3-7-7-3 7-3z"/>',home:'<path d="M3 11 12 3l9 8v10H3z"/>',bars:'<rect x="3" y="13" width="4" height="8"/><rect x="10" y="6" width="4" height="15"/><rect x="17" y="10" width="4" height="11"/>',gift:'<rect x="3" y="9" width="18" height="12"/><path d="M12 9v12M3 13h18M12 9s-7 0-7-5c0-4 7-2 7 5M12 9s7 0 7-5c0-4-7-2-7 5"/>',chev:'<path d="m9 6 6 6-6 6"/>',shield:'<path d="M12 2 4 6v6c0 5 3 8 8 10 5-2 8-5 8-10V6z"/>',mail:'<rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2"/><path d="m3 7 9 7 9-7"/>'};return `<svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">${paths[name]||paths.info}</svg>`}
function toast(msg){state.toast=msg;render();setTimeout(()=>{if(state.toast===msg){state.toast='';render();}},1900)}
function setPage(p){state.previous=state.page;state.page=p==='lobby'?'game':p;state.viewOpen=false;state.taskOpen=false;state.supplyOpen=false;render()}
function goBack(){setPage(state.previous&&state.previous!==state.page?state.previous:'game')}
function currentTask(){return `A-${1048+state.taskIndex}`}
function globalHeader(){return `<div class="global-header"><button class="global-profile" data-page="profile" aria-label="个人中心，能量20，积分${state.score}"><span class="mini-avatar">四</span><span class="identity-stats"><span class="identity-name">四七 <small>破壁人</small></span><span class="identity-resources"><span class="energy-symbol">ϟ <b>20</b></span><span class="energy-meter" aria-label="能量状态"><i></i></span><span class="credit-symbol">◇ <b>${state.score}</b></span></span></span></button><div class="global-header-actions"><button class="global-tool" data-page="gift" aria-label="馈赠与补给" title="馈赠与补给">${icon('gift')}</button><button class="global-tool" data-page="settings" aria-label="全局设置" title="系统设置">${icon('gear')}</button></div></div>`}
function gameEntryButtons(){return `<div class="game-entries"><div class="entry-main"><button class="scene-entry" data-page="archive" aria-label="回声档案">${icon('archive')}<span>回声档案</span></button><button class="scene-entry task-entry" id="open-task" aria-label="任务与进度">${icon('check')}<span>任务</span><span class="entry-count">${Math.min(state.taskIndex,state.total)}/${state.total}</span></button></div><div class="entry-utilities"><button class="utility-icon" data-page="help" aria-label="玩法帮助" title="任务帮助">${icon('info')}</button><button class="utility-icon" id="open-view" aria-label="视图与观察" title="视图设置">${icon('sliders')}</button></div></div>`}

function taskSheet(){return `<div class="overlay" id="taskoverlay"><div class="sheet compact-sheet" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="连接任务"><div class="handle"></div><div class="sheethead"><h2>连接任务</h2><button class="close" id="close-task" aria-label="关闭任务">×</button></div><p>任务与记录独立于游戏视觉区，打开时才展开。</p><div class="task-sheet-progress"><div><small>进度</small><strong>${Math.min(state.taskIndex,state.total)} / ${state.total}</strong></div><div class="track"><span style="width:${100*Math.min(state.taskIndex,state.total)/state.total}%"></span></div></div><div class="settingrow"><div><strong>${state.taskIndex>=state.total?'本轮演示已完成':'补全断裂神经纤维'}</strong><small>${state.taskIndex>=state.total?'可开始新一轮演示':`当前片段 ${currentTask()} · 选择两个端点`}</small></div></div><button class="inline-archive" data-page="archive">${icon('archive')} 查看回声档案</button></div></div>`}
function supplySheet(){return `<div class="overlay" id="supplyoverlay"><div class="sheet compact-sheet" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="礼包与补给"><div class="handle"></div><div class="sheethead"><h2>礼包与补给</h2><button class="close" id="close-supply" aria-label="关闭补给">×</button></div><p>这里演示外部资源入口，与底部的「馈赠」主页面区分。</p><div class="settingrow"><div><strong>探索补给</strong><small>补给规则暂未确认 · 未接入真实领取接口</small></div><button data-page="gift">查看馈赠</button></div></div></div>`}
function gameHTML(){const completed=state.taskIndex>=state.total;const n=state.taskIndex;
return `<section class="screen" id="game-screen" aria-label="神经纤维连接游戏">
<div class="scene-zoom palette-${state.palette} ${state.mode==='points'?'points-only':''}" id="scene" style="transform:scale(${state.zoom})"><img class="scene-base art-scene" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="神经纤维连接示意场景，非真实科研数据">
${!completed?`<svg class="current-connect ${state.connections.some(x=>x.status==='confirmed'&&x.index===n)?'connection-made':''}" viewBox="0 0 390 844" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M228 427 Q266 378 306 373" style="opacity:${state.selectedA&&state.selectedB?'1':'0'}"></path></svg><button id="nodeA" type="button" aria-label="选择节点 A" class="node-hit a ${state.selectedA?'selected':''} ${state.endpointsVisible?'':'quiet-endpoint'}"></button><button id="nodeB" type="button" aria-label="选择节点 B" class="node-hit b ${state.selectedB?'selected':''} ${state.endpointsVisible?'':'quiet-endpoint'}"></button>`:''}</div>
<div class="particle-layer" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div><div class="hud global-game-header">${globalHeader()}</div>
<div class="hud scene-top-actions">${gameEntryButtons()}</div>

${completed?`<div class="hud finished v06-finished"><h3>本轮任务已完成</h3><p>已记录 ${state.connections.filter(x=>x.status==='confirmed').length} 次演示连接</p><button id="restart">重新开始</button></div>`:`
<div class="hud actions game-actions"><button id="undo" class="square-action quiet-action" aria-label="撤回上一步"><span class="glyph icon-undo">↶</span><span>撤回</span></button><button id="connect" class="confirm compact-confirm" ${!(state.selectedA&&state.selectedB)?'disabled':''}><svg class="connect-emblem" viewBox="0 0 28 24" width="24" height="24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 18 21 6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="4" fill="#142333" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"/><circle cx="21" cy="6" r="4" fill="#142333" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"/></svg><span class="connect-label">连接</span></button><button id="endpoints" class="square-action quiet-action ${state.endpointsVisible?'selected-tool':''}" aria-label="切换末端显示"><span class="glyph">⊙</span><span>末端</span></button><button id="skip" class="square-action quiet-action"><span class="glyph">»</span><span>跳过</span></button></div>`}
${bottomNav('game')}
${state.viewOpen?viewSheet():''}${state.taskOpen?taskSheet():''}</section>`;}

function viewSheet(){return `<div class="overlay" id="viewoverlay"><div class="sheet" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="视图与观察工具"><div class="handle"></div><div class="sheethead"><h2>视图与观察工具</h2><button class="close" id="close-view" aria-label="关闭视图工具">×</button></div><p>仅调整当前示意神经图像的显示，不改变连接记录</p><div class="settingrow"><div><strong>显示模式</strong><small>${state.mode==='fibers'?'纤维与节点':'突出连接节点'}</small></div><button id="toggle-mode">切换模式</button></div><div class="settingrow"><div><strong>配色与对比度</strong><small>为不同显示需求切换效果</small></div><div class="colorchoices"><button class="cyan ${state.palette==='cyan'?'chosen':''}" data-color="cyan" aria-label="青蓝方案"></button><button class="violet ${state.palette==='violet'?'chosen':''}" data-color="violet" aria-label="紫蓝方案"></button><button class="contrast ${state.palette==='contrast'?'chosen':''}" data-color="contrast" aria-label="高对比方案"></button></div></div><div class="settingrow"><div><strong>观察视角</strong><small>缩放 ${Math.round(state.zoom*100)}%</small></div><button id="zoom-view">${state.zoom>=1.3?'重置视角':'放大场景'}</button></div></div></div>`}
function head(t,subtitle){return `<div class="subpage-head"><button id="go-back" class="subpage-back" aria-label="返回上一页">${icon('back')}</button><span>${t}</span></div>`}
function bottomNav(active){const items=[['game','home','研究'],['civil','star','文明'],['rank','bars','群星']];return `<nav class="bottom-nav" aria-label="主导航">${items.map(([page,ico,label])=>`<button class="nav-item ${page===active?'active':''}" data-page="${page}" aria-label="${label}" ${page===active?'aria-current="page"':''}><img class="nav-art-icon" src="${embeddedNav[page==='game'?'research':page==='civil'?'civil':'rank']}" alt=""/><span>${label}</span></button>`).join('')}</nav>`;}
const MAIN_PAGES=new Set(['game','civil','rank']);
function contentShell(inner,active){const main=MAIN_PAGES.has(active);return `<section class="page normal-page ${active==='rank'?'rank-page':''} ${main?'main-tab-page':'secondary-page'}">${inner}</section>${main?bottomNav(active):''}`;}

function smallEntry(ico,title,sub,target){return `<button class="hub-entry" data-page="${target}"><span class="hub-entry-icon">${icon(ico)}</span><span class="hub-entry-copy"><b>${title}</b><small>${sub}</small></span><span class="hub-chevron">${icon('chev')}</span></button>`}
function settingsHTML(){return contentShell(`${head('系统设置','应用偏好 · 帮助 · 隐私')}<div class="settings-group"><div class="group-label">体验与显示</div><div class="listrow"><span>音效 <small>演示中无音频输出</small></span><button class="togglebtn" id="toggle-sound">${state.sound?'开启':'关闭'}</button></div><div class="listrow"><span>减少动态效果 <small>降低非必要动画</small></span><button class="togglebtn" id="toggle-motion">${state.reducedMotion?'开启':'关闭'}</button></div></div><div class="settings-group"><div class="group-label">帮助与系统</div>${smallEntry('info','玩法帮助','了解连接任务的操作方式','help')}${smallEntry('shield','隐私与权限','演示未收集个人信息','privacy')}</div><div class="settings-group"><div class="group-label">账号入口</div>${smallEntry('user','个人中心','身份资料、贡献与账号安全','profile')}</div><p class="page-disclaimer">本页是视觉与流程示意，不代表已有真实后台设置接口。</p>`,'settings')}
function archiveHTML(){const records=state.connections.slice().reverse();const cases=[['C-037','皮层投射神经元','已完成','100%','2026-01-26'],['H-112','海马锥体神经元','进行中','64%','2026-01-26'],['T-089','丘脑中继神经元','待审核','100%','2026-01-26'],['C-036','皮层抑制性神经元','已完成','100%','2026-01-25'],['A-058','杏仁核神经元','进行中','37%','2026-01-25']];
return contentShell(`${head('回声档案','视觉概念演示 · 内容均为示例')}<div class="archive-hero-art"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="AI 生成的神经元示意插画"/><div><span class="archive-tag">当前档案 / 示例</span><h3>样本 C-037</h3><p>神经拓扑探索记录</p><span class="archive-hero-stat">研究进度 · 87%</span></div></div><div class="archive-tabs"><span class="active">轨迹档案</span><span>研究碎片</span></div><div class="archive-example-hint">以下是 AI 生成的虚构样例，不是科研或玩家实际数据。</div><div class="archive-art-list">${cases.map(([id,title,status,progress,date],i)=>`<div class="archive-art-row"><img src="${embeddedThumbs[i]}" alt="神经元示意缩略图"/><div class="archive-row-text"><strong>样本 ${id} · ${title}</strong><span>${date} · ${status}</span><div class="archive-meter"><i style="width:${progress}"></i></div></div><small>${progress}</small></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="hub-section-title"><span>本次演示操作</span><small>${records.length} 条</small></div><div class="record-list">${records.length?records.map(r=>`<div class="record-row"><span>${r.status==='confirmed'?'✓':'↷'}</span><div><b>${esc(r.id)}</b><small>${r.status==='confirmed'?'连线已确认':'已跳过'}</small></div><i>${r.status==='confirmed'?'+10':'—'}</i></div>`).join(''):'<div class="record-empty">还没有模拟操作记录。可以返回研究页完成一条连线。</div>'}</div><button class="secondary-cta" data-page="game">返回连接界面 →</button>`,'archive')}
function profileHTML(){return contentShell(`${head('个人中心','玩家身份与研究贡献')}<div class="profile-hero"><span class="profile-avatar">四</span><h3>四七</h3><p>破壁人 · RESEARCHER</p><div class="profile-metrics"><div><strong>ϟ 20</strong><small>能量点</small></div><div><strong>◇ ${state.score}</strong><small>贡献积分</small></div><div><strong>${state.connections.filter(x=>x.status==='confirmed').length}</strong><small>已确认连接</small></div></div></div><div class="hub-section-title"><span>账户与记录</span><small>仅展示信息架构</small></div><div class="settings-group">${smallEntry('archive','研究记录','查看已完成的连线任务','archive')}${smallEntry('shield','账号与隐私','账号信息、邮箱和权限','privacy')}${smallEntry('mail','收件信息','仅兑换实体物品时使用','gift')}</div><p class="page-disclaimer">账号登录、邮箱、地址等均为信息架构占位，没有接入真实用户资料。</p>`,'profile')}
function rankHTML(){const names=[['01','玩家 · 星云','归零者',6675],['02','玩家 · 晨星','破壁人',247],['03','玩家 · 光谱','破壁人',163],['04','玩家 · 行星','冬眠者',159],['05','玩家 · 远航','智子',149],['06','玩家 · 探索','冬眠者',98],['07','玩家 · 流光','监听员',94],['08','玩家 · 银河','归零者',87],['09','四七','面壁者',state.score],['10','玩家 · 萤光','破壁人',28],['11','玩家 · 初雪','监听员',22],['12','玩家 · 逐星','智子',19]];
return contentShell(`<div class="rank-tabs">${['周榜','月榜','总榜'].map(x=>`<button class="${state.rankPeriod===x?'sel':''}" data-period="${x}">${x}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="podium art-podium"><div class="podium-card second"><img class="podium-medal" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="银色神经徽章"/><b>玩家 · 晨星</b><small>247 积分</small></div><div class="podium-card first"><img class="podium-medal" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="金色神经徽章"/><b>玩家 · 星云</b><small>6675 积分</small></div><div class="podium-card third"><img class="podium-medal" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="铜色神经徽章"/><b>玩家 · 光谱</b><small>163 积分</small></div></div><div class="rank-header"><span>排名 / 玩家 / 称号</span><span>${state.rankPeriod}积分</span></div><div class="rank-list">${names.slice(3).map(([r,n,t,s],i)=>`<div class="rankcell ${n==='四七'?'mine':''}"><span class="ranknum">${r}</span><img class="rank-avatar-art" src="${embeddedThumbs[i%5]}" alt=""/><span class="rank-user"><b>${n}</b><small>${t}</small></span><strong>${s}</strong></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="rank-mine"><span>我的排名</span><b>#09 <em>四七</em></b><strong>${state.score}</strong></div>`,'rank')}

function civilHTML(){return contentShell(`<div class="civil-hero"><div class="tiny">CIVILIZATION / ARCHIVE</div><h3>每一条连接，都让图谱更完整</h3><p>用于展示文明探索、学习内容或叙事系统的结构占位，具体玩法尚未明确。</p></div>${smallEntry('archive','神经连接知识','探索真实任务的科学背景','archive')}${smallEntry('info','玩法说明','了解研究与游戏如何协作','help')}`,'civil')}
function giftHTML(){return contentShell(`${head('外源馈赠','奖励与兑换体系占位')}<div class="gift-hero"><div class="tiny">REWARD EXCHANGE</div><h3>研究贡献 · 探索回馈</h3><p>奖励规则和兑换机制尚未确认。本页仅验证普通页面布局与导航的一致性。</p></div><div class="card"><h3>贡献余额　◇ ${state.score}</h3><p>模拟积分不会兑换奖品，也不与真实账户数据互通。</p></div>${smallEntry('mail','收件资料','需要实物奖励时才出现','profile')}`,'gift')}
function helpHTML(){return contentShell(`${head('操作帮助','模拟神经纤维连线')}<div class="settings-group"><h3>如何完成任务</h3><p>① 选择观察区域中的两个端点。② 根据纤维连续性判断连接。③ 点击「确认连接」。</p><p>「视图」可调整显示模式、对比度及缩放；「回声档案」暂用于展示演示记录。</p></div><button class="secondary-cta" data-page="game">返回连接画面 →</button>`,'help')}
function privacyHTML(){return contentShell(`${head('账号与隐私','演示占位页')}<div class="settings-group"><h3>隐私与权限</h3><p>本 Demo 仅本地运行，不访问麦克风、摄像头、定位、账号和科研服务端，不上传任何连线结果。</p><p>正式项目需要数据处理协议、众包标注质量体系及个人信息政策。</p></div>${smallEntry('user','返回个人资料','玩家身份与贡献','profile')}`,'privacy')}
function render(){document.body.classList.toggle("reduce-animations",state.reducedMotion);const pages={game:gameHTML,lobby:gameHTML,settings:settingsHTML,archive:archiveHTML,profile:profileHTML,rank:rankHTML,civil:civilHTML,gift:giftHTML,help:helpHTML,privacy:privacyHTML};$('#app').innerHTML=pages[state.page]();if(state.toast)$('#app').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<div role="status" class="toast">${esc(state.toast)}</div>`);const stats=[['当前页面',state.page],['演示任务',`${Math.min(state.taskIndex,state.total)} / ${state.total}`],['已选端点',`${Number(state.selectedA)+Number(state.selectedB)} / 2`],['提交连接',state.connections.filter(x=>x.status==='confirmed').length],['跳过任务',state.connections.filter(x=>x.status==='skipped').length],['本次积分',state.score],['视图模式',state.mode],['视图配色',state.palette]];$('#inspector').innerHTML=stats.map(([k,v])=>`<div class="statrow"><span>${k}</span><b>${v}</b></div>`).join('');bind();fitPhone()}
function bind(){document.querySelectorAll('[data-page]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>setPage(b.dataset.page)));$('#go-back')?.addEventListener('click',goBack);$('#nodeA')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.selectedA=!state.selectedA;render()});$('#nodeB')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.selectedB=!state.selectedB;render()});$('#open-view')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.viewOpen=true;render()});$('#close-view')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.viewOpen=false;render()});$('#viewoverlay')?.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.id==='viewoverlay'){state.viewOpen=false;render()}});$('#open-task')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.taskOpen=true;render()});$('#close-task')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.taskOpen=false;render()});$('#taskoverlay')?.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.id==='taskoverlay'){state.taskOpen=false;render()}});$('#close-supply')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.supplyOpen=false;render()});$('#supplyoverlay')?.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.id==='supplyoverlay'){state.supplyOpen=false;render()}});$('#endpoints')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.endpointsVisible=!state.endpointsVisible;toast(state.endpointsVisible?'已突出显示末端':'已弱化末端标记')});$('#toggle-mode')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.mode=state.mode==='fibers'?'points':'fibers';render()});document.querySelectorAll('[data-color]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.palette=b.dataset.color;render()}));$('#zoom-view')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.zoom=state.zoom>=1.3?1:Math.round((state.zoom+.15)*100)/100;render()});$('#connect')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!(state.selectedA&&state.selectedB))return;state.connections.push({id:currentTask(),index:state.taskIndex,status:'confirmed'});state.score+=10;state.taskIndex++;state.selectedB=false;state.selectedA=true;toast('模拟连接已记录（未上传科研数据）')});$('#skip')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.connections.push({id:currentTask(),index:state.taskIndex,status:'skipped'});state.taskIndex++;state.selectedB=false;state.selectedA=true;toast('已跳过演示任务')});$('#undo')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(state.selectedB){state.selectedB=false;toast('已撤回节点 B 的选择');return}if(state.connections.length){const last=state.connections.pop();state.taskIndex=Math.max(0,state.taskIndex-1);if(last.status==='confirmed')state.score=Math.max(0,state.score-10);state.selectedB=false;toast('已撤回上一条演示记录');return}toast('当前没有可撤回的操作')});$('#restart')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.taskIndex=0;state.selectedA=true;state.selectedB=false;state.connections=[];state.score=68;toast('新一轮演示任务已重置')});$('#toggle-sound')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.sound=!state.sound;render()});$('#toggle-motion')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.reducedMotion=!state.reducedMotion;document.documentElement.style.setProperty('scroll-behavior',state.reducedMotion?'auto':'smooth');toast('演示偏好已更新')});$('#help-info')?.addEventListener('click',()=>toast('本版测试：选择端点 B，再点击确认连接'));$('#account-info')?.addEventListener('click',()=>toast('账号接口尚未接入；这里不会修改真实账户'));document.querySelectorAll('[data-period]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.rankPeriod=b.dataset.period;render()}))}
function fitPhone(){const h=$('.phone-holder'),p=$('.phone');if(!h||!p)return;const mobile=window.innerWidth<=900;const scale=mobile?Math.min(window.innerWidth/390,window.innerHeight/844):1;h.style.width=`${390*scale}px`;h.style.height=`${844*scale}px`;p.style.transform=`scale(${scale})`}
window.addEventListener('resize',fitPhone);
$('#reset-all').addEventListener('click',()=>{Object.assign(state,{page:'game',previous:'game',viewOpen:false,taskOpen:false,supplyOpen:false,endpointsVisible:true,selectedA:true,selectedB:false,taskIndex:0,total:2,score:68,connections:[],palette:'cyan',mode:'fibers',zoom:1,sound:true,reducedMotion:false,toast:'',rankPeriod:'周榜'});render()});
document.getElementById('workflow-open').addEventListener('click',()=>document.body.classList.add('workflow-open'));
document.getElementById('workflow-close').addEventListener('click',()=>document.body.classList.remove('workflow-open'));
document.getElementById('workflow-scrim').addEventListener('click',()=>document.body.classList.remove('workflow-open'));
document.getElementById('toggle-demo-motion').addEventListener('click',()=>{state.reducedMotion=!state.reducedMotion;render();document.getElementById('toggle-demo-motion').textContent='减少动态效果：'+(state.reducedMotion?'开':'关')});
// The code-first page is the design source. Screenshot/interaction QA is a separate gate.
window.neurotraceDemo={state,render,reset:()=>$('#reset-all').click()};
render();
</script></body></html>
